rss: Struggling households need more help with bills, energy industry says
title: PowerUp Needs To Boost Help
story: PowerUp, the electricity company, says some families need more help paying their energy bills. They think there should be more support for those who need it most.
storyBig: PowerUp has expressed concerns that current assistance measures for struggling households are insufficient. They advocate for enhanced support mechanisms to ensure families can manage their energy costs effectively.
think: What can companies do to help families save on energy costs?
bull: Helping families could make PowerUp more popular!
bear: If PowerUp can't help enough, some families might struggle.

rss: CrossCountry cancels 'almost all' UK services after power cut
title: Train Trouble: Power Outage Causes Chaos
story: The TrainLand express had to stop almost all its trains because the power went out! Lots of people had to change their plans.
storyBig: TrainLand experienced a major disruption after a power cut led to widespread service cancellations. The incident left many passengers scrambling for alternative travel options, causing significant inconvenience.
think: What should TrainLand do to avoid such problems in the future?
bull: TrainLand can work on making their trains even better!
bear: If trains stop often, people might not take them anymore.
